Use the coefficient of thermal expansion of the aluminum film as 23 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the coefficient of thermal expansion of the ceramic substrate as 8 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the temperature change as −180 K.
The thermal-mismatch strain in the bonded film is computed as (α_substrate − α_film) × ΔT.
The result is 2.7 × 10⁻³.
The strain is tensile in the film, not compressive.
